case_analysis.thread_summary: An internal thread ([COMPANY] Ariion sales + senior consultant) handling two separate Bluetooth SIG registration proxy cases for [COMPANY] Shibutani (product 'Tebura' and one other). The customer had an expired quote and asked two questions: (1) whether the SIG payment could be sent before the 'simplified test' results, and (2) what the Compliance Folder is. Internally, the sales person (Iida) forwarded the customer inquiry to the consultant (Sakai) to confirm test requirements and quote re-issuance details. Sakai clarified that all tests are fully exempt for these registrations (no test of any kind is needed), confirmed payment can proceed immediately, and provided instructions for re-issuing two separate quotes at their respective prices (¥400,000 for Mori-san's Tebura case, ¥300,000 for the other case re-issued 2025/12/28).
all_questions_found: Can the customer send SIG payment (Declaration Fee) before the simplified test results are ready?
What is the Bluetooth SIG Compliance Folder, why is it required, and how is it delivered?
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The thread highlights that 'simplified test' (簡易試験) is a customer-used term that may refer to the 2-item RF PHY test sometimes required for derivative models; however, in this case the registrations are fully test-exempt (consistent with a derivative model with unchanged BLE FW and antenna path, or an End Product referencing a pre-certified Component QDID). Sakai explicitly clarified that all tests are exempt, so no simplified test exists. The Compliance Folder explanation covers its nature (technical documents + certifications), retention obligation (post-shipment, per SIG policy), audit use case, and delivery method (CD-R from the certification service provider). The internal exchange also reveals the operational practice of re-issuing expired quotes at the same price for established customer relationships.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: When assessing test requirements for a registration: confirm whether any test (full RF PHY, 2-item RF PHY, or other) is actually required. If registrations are fully test-exempt, inform the customer explicitly to prevent misunderstanding about payment timing. SIG payment (Declaration Fee) is not blocked by pending test results - these are separate process tracks, and test-exempt registrations have no test dependency at all.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: If a customer incorrectly believes they must wait for test results before paying the SIG Declaration Fee, they may cause unnecessary delays in the registration timeline. If the Compliance Folder is not properly created and retained, the company would be unprepared for a SIG market audit.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Proactively clarify whether tests are required when a customer uses terms like '簡易試験' (simplified test) - they may not know whether testing applies to their specific registration type. Always explain the Compliance Folder when it appears in a quote, since it is unfamiliar to most customers. Make clear that SIG payment timing is independent of test completion, especially for test-exempt registrations where no test dependency exists.
